clue.text: Sailor to burn food brought aboard

indicators.note: something brought aboard a ship ends up inside it, so one word is placed within the other

parts.note: to sear is to burn or scorch
fare is food, as in good plain fare

explanation.surface: A ship's cook is told to char the provisions taken on board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought aboard' is the containment signal: the food is taken on board the verb for burning, the way cargo goes into a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A seafarer is a person who travels by sea, especially a mariner by trade.

clue.text: German writer needs second fridge cabinet

parts.note: a chiller is a refrigerated cabinet for keeping food cold

explanation.surface: A German author apparently requires a spare refrigerator unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Friedrich Schiller was the German poet and playwright of the Ode to Joy and William Tell.

clue.text: Notice superior army officer being mature

parts.note: an ad, short for advertisement, is a notice
U stands for upper class, socially superior, in British usage
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, an army officer

explanation.surface: A recruit observes that a senior officer behaves in a grown-up way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'superior' as U is the British label for upper-class speech and manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone mature is fully grown, an adult rather than a child.

clue.text: A 'no good' fish? Not what's wanted in this sport

parts.note: a ling is a long-bodied sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An angler grumbles that a worthless catch is the last thing anyone in the sport wants.
explanation.walkthrough: The words 'Not what's wanted in' comment on the wordplay: a fish that is no good is unwelcome to an angler, so the whole clue paints the sport it defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Fishing with rod and line is the pastime that the clue's sport refers to.

clue.text: Greek characters contributing to the task

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Figures from Greece are helping with the job in hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet, so these are letters of that script.

clue.text: Like a picture I study and I start to copy

parts.note: to con is to study or pore over, an old sense

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, taken from copy

explanation.surface: An art student explains how they set about reproducing a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Iconic means relating to an icon, a picture or image, especially a religious one.

clue.text: Perfume of the Rhine?

parts.note: a scent famously named after a German city that stands on the river Rhine

explanation.definitionFit: Eau de toilette from that city gave its name to light scented water, while the city itself lies on the Rhine.

clue.text: City we clean carelessly, passing over street

indicators.note: the jumbled letters pass over the street, enclosing it within them
doing a job carelessly leaves things in disorder, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Residents grumble that the council's road sweepers do a sloppy job of the town's roads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carelessly' turns WE CLEAN into NEWCALE; 'passing over' means those jumbled letters straddle the abbreviation for street.
explanation.definitionFit: Newcastle upon Tyne is a major city in north-east England.

clue.text: Minister wants radiocative material boxed

annotationWithheld.why: Minister wants radiocative material boxed (6): CURATE reads as U (radioactive material) in CRATE, but 'boxed' must give both CRATE and the containment, a word doing two jobs

clue.text: Slim-waisted girl faced with rough drunk

indicators.note: faced with means the girl has the other piece in front of her
being drunk leaves one reeling and muddled, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: a lass is a girl, especially in northern Britain

explanation.surface: A shapely young woman is confronted by a rowdy, inebriated man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges the five letters into HOURG, and 'faced with' sets that in front of the word for a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: An hourglass figure is a woman's shape with a narrow waist between fuller bust and hips, like the sand timer.

clue.text: Mammal in snare struggling, one trapped

indicators.note: something trapped is held inside, so one piece sits within the other
an animal struggling in a trap thrashes about, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An animal caught in a wire noose fights to free itself while a single creature is caught.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggling' turns IN SNARE into SIRENAN, and 'trapped' puts I inside it after SIREN.
explanation.definitionFit: Sirenians are the order of aquatic mammals that includes dugongs and manatees, the sea cows.

clue.text: Case for small letters

parts.note: reads like a container for little envelopes, but printers kept small type in the bottom one of two trays

explanation.definitionFit: Printers stored small letters in the bottom type case, hence the term for minuscule letters.

clue.text: Not on time, not quite, going through country

indicators.note: not quite means the word falls short of its full length, losing its final letter

parts.note: late means not on time
via means going through or by way of

explanation.surface: A traveller arrives behind schedule while passing across a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Latvia is a Baltic state in north-eastern Europe.

clue.text: Frequently getting a gift like 6?

parts.note: a grant is a gift of money or property

explanation.surface: Someone often receives a present that resembles the perfume at 6.
explanation.definitionFit: Eau de Cologne is sweet-smelling, so something resembling it is pleasantly scented.

clue.text: Tears shed, about to pass away, shaking less

indicators.note: about means going around, so the jumbled letters surround the other piece
tears that are shed fall in disorder, so these letters are scattered

parts.note: to die is to pass away

explanation.surface: Tears flow as someone faces death, yet they become calmer and tremble less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' rearranges the clue's first word into STEAR, and 'about' wraps that round the verb meaning pass away.
explanation.definitionFit: Steadier means firmer and more stable, the opposite of trembling.

clue.text: Hint : gentlemen should change to show understanding

indicators.note: the words are told to change, so their letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A tip that the men in the room ought to alter their ways to demonstrate insight.
explanation.walkthrough: The colon is surface punctuation; HINT and GENTLEMEN together are the thirteen letters rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlightenment is insight or full comprehension of a matter.

clue.text: Bill may sit in it until someone comes home

definitions.text: Bill may sit in it until someone comes home

parts.words: Bill may sit in it until someone comes home
parts.note: Bill reads as a man waiting, but it is an invoice lying in the slot in the front door

explanation.definitionFit: Post such as an invoice is pushed through the door slot and stays there until the occupant returns.

clue.text: Alien murderer left to escape

indicators.note: a letter allowed to escape drops out of the word

parts.note: a strangler is a murderer who throttles victims

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial killer slips away, abandoning the scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to escape' removes the L from STRANGLER.
explanation.definitionFit: A stranger is an outsider or foreigner, someone from elsewhere.

clue.text: Go to row z and let others get on with it

definitions.meaning: literally move to the last row of seats, at the back of the auditorium

definitions.text: let others get on with it
definitions.meaning: withdraw from involvement and leave others in charge

explanation.definitionFit: Retiring to the rear row and stepping aside to give others control are the literal and figurative senses of the idiom.

clue.text: Viceroy, king and ambassador needing refuge

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
HE stands for His Excellency, the form of address for an ambassador
a dive is a low hideaway or haunt where one takes refuge

explanation.surface: A governor, a monarch and a diplomat all seek somewhere safe to shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: The khedive was the title of the Ottoman Turkish viceroy who ruled Egypt.

clue.text: Aroused type went ahead

parts.note: a kind is a type or sort
led means went in front, at the head

explanation.surface: Someone excited a particular sort of person who then took the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindled means stirred up or awakened, as passion or interest is.

clue.text: Show contempt when drinking Irish whiskey?

indicators.note: someone drinking takes something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to spit is to show contempt or scorn

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at a drinker knocking back a glass of the hard stuff from Dublin.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that whiskey is just one example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Whiskey is one kind of distilled alcoholic liquor, which is called a spirit.

clue.text: Prettier (sadly!) in the past

indicators.note: sadly suggests things have gone wrong, so these letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Someone laments that they were better-looking in former days.
explanation.definitionFit: The preterit is the grammatical tense for actions completed in former time, the simple past.

clue.text: A new set taking on a girl

parts.note: to gel is to set, as a jelly does

explanation.surface: A fresh group takes on a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Angela is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Be stuck initially in the passage out

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed inside the other word

parts.note: an exit is a way or passage out

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of stuck

explanation.surface: Someone finds themselves jammed at the start of the corridor leading outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes the first letter of 'stuck', and 'in' places it inside the word for a way out, just before its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To exist is simply to be, to have life or reality.

clue.text: Man involved in province's uprising

indicators.note: in a down clue an uprising means the letters are read upwards, in reverse
involved in signals a run of letters wrapped up inside the word that follows

explanation.surface: A fellow is caught up in a regional rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' picks ROVI out of 'province's' and 'uprising' turns it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivor is a man's first name, of Welsh origin.

clue.text: Jewish leader contributing to Arab bile

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A religious figure is blamed for stoking bitterness among Arabs.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher and leader of a congregation.

clue.text: Act of rebel is disgusting

definitions.meaning: rising up against authority, the action a rebel takes

explanation.definitionFit: Rising in revolt is what rebels do, and something repulsive is said to turn the stomach in the same word.

clue.text: A team man gathered round and sent by cab

indicators.note: people gathered round something enclose it, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: Ted is a man's name
XI, eleven, is a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A squad member was rounded up and dispatched in a taxi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathered round' has the man's name enclose A and the team. Eleven, written in Roman numerals, is the size of a cricket or football side.
explanation.definitionFit: Taxied means travelled or carried in a taxi, the motor hire vehicle.

clue.text: Director sacked someone not yet paid

indicators.note: a director who is sacked is thrown out, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A company boss is fired and left still waiting for his wages.
explanation.definitionFit: A creditor is a person or firm owed money by a debtor.
